description: Backend: additive live pool import. Tail-queue model (room.addedQueue, poolMeta FOLLOW/HELD, poolImports), engine selection changes, RELEASE_POOL_ADDITIONS command, import service (preview/commit with server-side validation, pricing, idempotent batchId), HTTP routes with raised bodyLimit, PLAYER_POOL_UPDATED event, roomState.poolAdditions, timer-reschedule guard in app.ts, docs, and full backend tests. Implements plan.md items 1-5; plan.md section 0-2 are the binding design. Independent of FEAT-002 but FEAT-002 depends on its HTTP/event/state contract.
steps: Item 1: add defaultPoolBasePriceCr to domain/pricing.ts and use it in csvRowToPlayer; export fc26 rowSchema/toRecord from fc26.importer.ts (no behavior change).

Item 2: types in domain/types.ts; pool-additions.ts helpers; engine planNext/VOTE_SKIP/START_RECALL/END_AUCTION/activateNext changes; RELEASE_POOL_ADDITIONS in auction.schemas.ts and engine; assertRoom invariants in squad.service.ts.
Item 3: pool-import.types/parser/service.ts per plan.md (limits, schema detection, eligibility outcomes, commit inside manager.mutate, batchId idempotency).
Item 4: pool-import.routes.ts + app.ts registration and timers.schedule skip for pool-only events; roomState poolAdditions; update backend/WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md and add LIVE_ADD_PLAYERS.md.
Item 5: write backend/tests/live-add-players.test.ts covering every acceptance case listed in plan.md item 5.
Commit locally (conventional commit); do not push.
acceptance_criteria: Importing during a live lot leaves room.active (playerId, activationId, endsAt, currentBidUnits, highestBidderTeamId), purchases, bids, budgets, existing players order and playerQueue deep-equal
New players are WAITING with poolMeta (PENDING, importBatchId, importedAt, importedBy, sourceFile, sourceCategory) and server-computed base price; existing players unmodified
Sold, live, unsold, retained, in-pool and in-file duplicates are skipped and invalid rows rejected, each with a reason; counts reported
Active-category additions are FOLLOW and play only after all regular waiting players; completed-category additions are HELD, never activated until host RELEASE_POOL_ADDITIONS
Concurrent bid + commit both succeed; double commit with same CSV or same batchId adds once; non-host/non-member/LOBBY/COMPLETED rejected
Pool, addedQueue and poolImports survive a simulated server restart and appear in ROOM_STATE; all connected clients get PLAYER_POOL_UPDATED then ROOM_STATE
timers.schedule is not invoked for a pool-only commit; completion archive works with imported players
No migration file added or applied

findings:
BACKEND DONE (FEAT-001). Contract for FEAT-002:

HTTP (Bearer auth, host only, status must be RUNNING or PAUSED; LOBBY/COMPLETED -> 409 INVALID_STATE; non-host 403 HOST_REQUIRED; non-member 403 NOT_ROOM_MEMBER; 10 req/min; body limit 2 MB):
  POST /api/rooms/:code/pool-import/preview  and  POST /api/rooms/:code/pool-import/commit
  Body (strict, unknown keys -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR): { source:'CSV'|'FC26_DATABASE'|'DEFAULT_POOL', fileName?:string, csv?:string (<=1,500,000 chars, <=1000 rows), playerIds?:string[<=500], potIds?:string[], search?:string, batchId?:uuid }
  batchId is REQUIRED for commit (generate crypto.randomUUID(); reusing it with identical content returns the stored report with duplicate:true and commits nothing; reusing with different content -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT). FC26_DATABASE only in FC26 rooms, DEFAULT_POOL only in default rooms (else 409 SOURCE_MISMATCH).
  Response (both): { mode:'PREVIEW'|'COMMIT', batchId?, duplicate?, sequence, totals:{ totalRecords, eligible, added, skipped, rejected, byReason:Record<code,number> }, rows:[{ row, playerId, name, positions?:string[], ovr?, potId?, categoryState?:'ACTIVE'|'COMPLETED'|'NOT_IN_AUCTION', basePriceCr?, underdog?, status:'ELIGIBLE'|'SKIPPED'|'REJECTED', code, reason }] }
  Preview: added=0. Commit: added = number of ELIGIBLE rows. Row codes: ELIGIBLE; SKIPPED: DUPLICATE_IN_FILE, RETAINED, CURRENTLY_LIVE, SOLD, ALREADY_UNSOLD, ALREADY_IN_POOL; REJECTED: INVALID (reason text says why).
  Whole-file errors (HTTP error body {error:{code,message,...}}): 400 EMPTY_FILE, INVALID_CSV, MISSING_COLUMNS (message lists accepted columns), TOO_MANY_ROWS, BATCH_ID_REQUIRED; 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE.
  CSV columns: FC26 schema (has player_positions): required player_id, player_positions, overall, short_name|long_name; optional potential, nationality_name, club_name, league_name, age, preferred_foot, pace, shooting, passing, dribbling, defending, physic, player_face_url, draft_pool (UNDERDOG) , underdog_tag. Default schema: required player_id, name, overall, auction_group(GK/DEF/MID/ATT)|position; optional club, nationality, age, preferred_foot, image_url, pace..physical, secondary_positions, league, rating_tier. Client prices ignored.

WS command (host): { type:'RELEASE_POOL_ADDITIONS', requestId?, payload:{ roomCode, playerIds?:string[1..2000] (omit = all held), expectedSequence? } }. Errors: NO_HELD_ADDITIONS 409, PLAYER_NOT_RELEASABLE 409, HOST_REQUIRED, INVALID_STATE.

WS events (each followed by the usual per-viewer ROOM_STATE at the same sequence):
  PLAYER_POOL_UPDATED payload { auctionId, roomCode, batchId, addedCount, addedPlayerIds:string[], addedPlayers:[{ playerId, category:potId, releaseState:'FOLLOW'|'HELD' }], categoryCounts:Record<potId,number>, heldCount, importedAt:epochMs }  (only emitted when addedCount>0; the frontend parseServerEvent whitelist must add this name)
  POOL_ADDITIONS_RELEASED payload { playerIds:string[], count }

ROOM_STATE additions:
  players[].poolMeta?: { poolStatus:'PENDING', importBatchId, importedAt, importedBy(userId), sourceFile, sourceCategory, release:'FOLLOW'|'HELD' }  (stays on the player after activation; NEW badge should show only while status is WAITING/waiting)
  playerQueueSummary: { remaining, heldAdditions }  (remaining still counts held players)
  poolAdditions: { pendingCount, followCount, heldCount, held:[{ playerId, potId }], batches:[{ batchId, at, addedCount, addedPlayerIds, categoryCounts, heldCount, sourceFile, importedBy, totalRecords, skippedCount, rejectedCount, skipped?, rejected? }] }  newest batch first, max 20; skipped/rejected arrays ([{row,playerId,name,code,reason}]) only for the host viewer.
  Added players are WAITING, round 0, appended at the end of players[] (existing order unchanged). FOLLOW = plays automatically after all ordinary waiting players; HELD = category was completed or absent, stays waiting until host RELEASE_POOL_ADDITIONS.
  Pot ids: FC26 rooms GK/CB/FB/MID/ATT; default rooms GK/DEF/MID/ATT. Underdogs have draftPool/playerTag 'UNDERDOG' and sourceCategory 'UNDERDOG'.
